questions.q_en: Before we go deep: what physically drives liquid across the fibre wall, and what sets how much permeate you actually get?
questions.q_zh: 先問基本的：是什麼把液體推過纖維壁的？你們實際收到多少滲透液，又是由什麼決定的？
questions.a_en: Transmembrane pressure drives it, but in practice a pump sets the rate. Permeation follows the pressure difference across the wall, and our membrane cycles recommend 263 millilitres a minute at a transmembrane pressure of 0.30 bar. In a run, though, a second pump draws the shell side at a rate we choose: 24 millilitres a minute on 8 October, halved to 12 for the 14 October run and raised to 17 for the 17 October run. There is no permeate flow meter, so what we know is the pump setting, not a measured flux. On 200 square centimetres, 12 millilitres a minute is about 36 LMH.
questions.a_zh: 是跨膜壓在驅動，但實際上速率是幫浦設定的。滲透量取決於膜兩側的壓差，我們的薄膜循環建議的操作點是 263 mL/min、跨膜壓 0.30 bar。不過真正運轉時，是第二顆幫浦按我們設定的速率把殼側抽出來：10 月 8 日是 24 mL/min，10 月 14 日那次減半到 12，10 月 17 日那次提高到 17。我們沒有裝滲透側流量計，所以我們知道的是幫浦設定值，不是量到的通量。以 200 平方公分來算，12 mL/min 大約是 36 LMH。
questions.trap_en: Quoting the 2 LMH design flux as what the reactor runs at. Every scaling number on Biomanufacturing uses 2 LMH, while the October runs drew 36 and 51 LMH, and the user manual says the transmembrane pressure is a few kilopascals in normal operation, not 0.30 bar.
questions.trap_zh: 把 2 LMH 的設計通量講成反應器實際的操作值。Biomanufacturing 上每個放大數字都用 2 LMH，但十月那兩次運轉抽的是 36 和 51 LMH；而使用手冊寫的是正常運轉下跨膜壓只有幾個 kPa，不是 0.30 bar。
questions.basis: a judge checks whether the headline flux is measured, assumed, or simply a pump setting

questions.q_en: You report the fouling trend as permeability halving from 2,520 to 1,210, and you also say no fouling threshold was reached, with the alarm set at seventy per cent of steady state. Reconcile those two for me.
questions.q_zh: 你們把污垢趨勢寫成通透率從 2,520 掉到 1,210、少了一半，同時又說沒有觸發任何污垢門檻，而警報設在穩態的七成。請幫我把這兩件事對起來。
questions.a_en: I cannot fully reconcile them, and that is a fair hit. Over the 77 hour run on 17 October the pressure the module needed beyond clean water at the same flow rose from 1.9 to 4.4 kilopascals, and permeability fell from 2,520 to 1,210 litres per square metre per hour per bar. Our controller alarms when permeability drops below seventy per cent of steady state, and a halving is well past that, yet our pages say no threshold was reached. Either the alarm is keyed to a steady state we never established, or the trace and the alarm are not the same quantity. We should state which. The baseline is one clean-water sweep on one module.
questions.a_zh: 我沒辦法完全對起來，這個質疑是合理的。10 月 17 日那次 77 小時運轉，模組在同樣流量下比清水多需要的壓力從 1.9 升到 4.4 kPa，通透率從 2,520 掉到 1,210 LMH/bar。我們的控制器設定是通透率低於穩態的七成就警報，減半早就超過了，可是我們頁面上寫沒有觸發任何門檻。要嘛那個警報是對著一個我們從來沒建立起來的穩態，要嘛曲線上那個量和警報監看的量根本不是同一個。我們應該把是哪一種寫清楚。而且基線只有同一個模組的一次清水掃描。
questions.trap_en: Saying the rise is small so the membrane is fine. The absolute kilopascals are small, but a permeability halving is the number the alarm is written against, and the comparison baseline is a single sweep on a single module.
questions.trap_zh: 說壓力升幅很小、所以膜沒問題。絕對的 kPa 數字確實小，但警報判準寫的就是通透率，而通透率掉了一半；而且比較用的基線只有單一模組的單次掃描。
questions.basis: the project's own fouling datum and its own alarm threshold disagree in print

questions.q_en: Your pages name the duty-cycled recirculation pump as the next experiment and say you have not run it. Predict for me what happens inside the fibres during the off phase.
questions.q_zh: 你們的頁面把「循環幫浦間歇運轉」列為下一個實驗，也說還沒做。請預測一下：停機那段時間，纖維裡面會發生什麼事？
questions.a_en: Cells would settle in the lumens and I would expect the fouling trace to rise faster. Duty cycling the recirculation pump cuts the dominant electrical load, the cumulative shear exposure and the medium draw all at once, which is why it is the first experiment we would run on the hardware side. The risk is that wall shear is the thing sweeping the membrane, and with the pump off there is none. A one millimetre bore is narrow enough for a dense culture to sediment, and our very first loop failed on sedimentation until we put a stirrer under the reservoir. We have no backflush or relaxation step either, and no cleaning protocol: a fouled module is replaced.
questions.a_zh: 細胞會在管腔裡沉下來，我預期污垢曲線會升得更快。讓循環幫浦間歇運轉可以同時減少最大的耗電、累積剪切暴露和培養基用量，所以這是硬體端我們最想先做的實驗。風險在於掃膜靠的就是壁剪切，幫浦停掉就完全沒有。1 毫米的內徑對高密度菌液來說夠細，足以沉降；我們最早那版迴路就是敗在沉降，後來在儲液瓶下面加了攪拌子才解決。而且我們既沒有逆洗也沒有鬆弛步驟，連清洗程序都沒有：模組髒了是直接換掉。
questions.trap_en: Answering that the biology responds over hours so the off phase is harmless. That is the argument for trying it; the open question is settling and fouling in the fibres, which nobody has measured.
questions.trap_zh: 回答「生物反應是以小時為尺度，所以停機沒差」。那是「值得一試」的理由；真正未知的是纖維裡的沉降與結垢，沒有人量過。
questions.basis: the highest-value unrun hardware experiment the team has named itself

questions.q_en: A 0.2 micron pore and a protein running at about forty kilodaltons. Explain why the protein goes through and a cell does not, and then tell me what else goes through.
questions.q_zh: 0.2 微米的孔徑，配上一個大約四十千道爾頓的蛋白。請解釋為什麼蛋白過得去、細胞過不去；然後告訴我還有什麼東西也會一起過去。
questions.a_en: Size, and nothing cleverer. The pore is 200 nanometres. Our ACC deaminase runs at about 42 kilodaltons on the blot, a few nanometres across, so it passes freely, while a Bacillus cell is micrometre scale and cannot. That means the barrier is cellular, not molecular. Vesicles and cell debris in the 20 to 200 nanometre range go through with the protein, along with every medium component. We used to specify a 50 kilodalton cut-off and claim the membrane retained vesicles; when we froze the specification against the invoices we found the part is 0.2 micron microfiltration and withdrew both claims in writing.
questions.a_zh: 就是尺寸，沒有更聰明的機制。孔徑是 200 奈米。我們的 ACC deaminase 在膜上跑在大約 42 kDa，直徑只有幾奈米，所以輕鬆通過，而 Bacillus 的細胞是微米級，過不去。這表示這層阻隔是細胞級的，不是分子級的。20 到 200 奈米的囊泡和細胞碎片會跟蛋白一起出去，培養基成分也都會。我們以前的規格寫 50 kDa 截留、還說膜能擋住囊泡；後來把規格對著發票凍結時，發現買到的是 0.2 微米微過濾模組，就把這兩個說法正式撤掉了。
questions.trap_en: Quoting one cell size as settled. Safety, the Bioreactor page and Contribution say 0.25 to 1.0 micron; Results and the fouling model say a 1 to 2 micron rod and 0.8 by 3 microns, with no citation. Say which page you are quoting.
questions.trap_zh: 把某一個細胞尺寸講成定論。Safety、Bioreactor 頁和 Contribution 寫 0.25 到 1.0 微米；Results 和污垢模型寫 1 到 2 微米的桿狀、還有 0.8 乘 3 微米，而且都沒有引用。要說清楚你引的是哪一頁。
questions.basis: the withdrawn molecular-weight cut-off is the team's best honesty story and a judge will test whether they understand it

questions.q_en: Your bioreactor page headlines that the lumen and shell sides read the same, 10.7 against 10.5 by ELISA. Your Results page says the port each sample came from was never recorded. Which is it, and what sieving coefficient do you have?
questions.q_zh: 你們 Bioreactor 頁的主打結果是管腔側和殼側讀數一樣，ELISA 10.7 對 10.5。可是 Results 頁說每個樣品是從哪個接口抽的根本沒有記錄。到底是哪一個？你們的篩分係數是多少？
questions.a_en: Both are on our wiki and they do not sit together. The 8 October ELISA gives 10.7 micrograms per millilitre in the lumen against 10.5 on the shell side, with a time course where both sides peak near 16 hours and stay within about 0.8 of each other. Our Results page then says that for the October reactor samples the record does not say which port each was drawn from, and quotes 3.4 to 6.5 across both runs. Most samples also read above the top standard of about 3 micrograms per millilitre, so they are extrapolated. We have no sieving coefficient. A paired lumen and shell sample with the port written down is what would give us one.
questions.a_zh: 這兩段都在我們 wiki 上，而且對不起來。10 月 8 日的 ELISA 給出管腔側 10.7 µg/mL、殼側 10.5，時間序列上兩側都在大約 16 小時達到高峰，彼此相差約 0.8 以內。可是我們 Results 頁又說，十月那兩次反應器樣品的記錄沒有寫每一個是從哪個接口抽的，並且報的是兩次運轉合起來 3.4 到 6.5。另外多數樣品都讀在最高標準品（大約 3 µg/mL）之上，所以數值是外推的。我們沒有篩分係數。要拿到它，需要的是一組配對的管腔與殼側樣品，而且把接口寫下來。
questions.trap_en: Defending 10.7 against 10.5 as proof the protein crosses freely. Two numbers that close cannot be defended when the ports are unrecorded, the values are extrapolated above the top standard, and Results says membrane passage is not conclusively demonstrated.
questions.trap_zh: 拿 10.7 對 10.5 當成蛋白自由通過的證明。接口沒記錄、數值是超出最高標準品的外推值，而 Results 還寫著過膜尚未確證——這麼接近的兩個數字守不住。
questions.basis: the project's central product claim rests on numbers its own Results page will not assign to a side

questions.q_en: What is the pinch valve really for? Convince me it is not just a tap.
questions.q_zh: 那顆夾管閥到底是幹什麼的？說服我它不只是一個開關。
questions.a_en: It exists because an expert found a hole in our design. On 18 June Professor Chang pointed out that nothing was pushing the protectant from the lumen to the shell side, and that a higher flow rate would only recirculate the fluid. He recommended a valve after the membrane. So the pinch valve clamps the return line about fifty millimetres past the out-lumen port and builds the pressure across the fibres. It is also the safety actuator: past 0.5 bar on lumen-in or transmembrane pressure for five samples running it releases and latches a fault, and a separate 0.70 bar trip stops both pumps. We chose a servo over a stepper because a stepper releases when the power is cut.
questions.a_zh: 它會存在，是因為外部專家指出我們設計上的一個漏洞。6 月 18 日張教授點出：沒有任何東西把保護蛋白從管腔側推到殼側，而且把流量開大只是讓液體一直繞圈而已。他建議在膜之後加一顆閥。所以這顆夾管閥夾住離出管腔口大約 50 毫米的回流管，建立起纖維兩側的壓差。它同時是安全執行件：管腔入口或跨膜壓超過 0.5 bar、連續五個取樣就會釋放並鎖定故障，另外還有一個獨立的 0.70 bar 跳脫會停掉兩顆幫浦。我們選伺服而不是步進，是因為步進一斷電就鬆開。
questions.trap_en: Describing it only as pressure regulation. Half the answer is that an outside reviewer found the gap it fills, and the other half is that holding position on power loss is why it is a servo, with a live culture in the loop.
questions.trap_zh: 只把它講成壓力調節。答案的一半是「這個缺口是外部審查者指出來的」，另一半是「斷電時能保持位置」才是選伺服的理由——因為迴路裡是活的菌液。
questions.basis: user feedback driving a specific hardware change is a Hardware judging criterion

questions.q_en: Where does your culture see the most shear, in the pump head or in the fibre lumen, and how do you know it is tolerable?
questions.q_zh: 你們的菌液受到最大剪切的地方是在幫浦頭還是纖維管腔？你怎麼知道細胞承受得住？
questions.a_en: In the fibre by calculation, but the pump may be what actually damages the protein. At our recommended 263 millilitres a minute the wall shear is about 4,064 per second, mid-range in the vendor's 2,000 to 6,000 window, and two independent routes to that number agree within 2.8 per cent. The first step is to divide cross-flow by the fibre count; feeding the pump total into the single-fibre formula overstates shear by that factor, and we found that error in more than one published write-up. A walled Bacillus is not a CHO cell, so single pass is safe. Cumulative exposure is open: about 138 passes an hour, and van Reis blames aggregation on pump passages and air entrainment.
questions.a_zh: 用算的是在纖維裡，但真正可能傷到蛋白的是幫浦。在我們建議的 263 mL/min 下，壁剪切大約 4,064 /s，落在廠商 2,000 到 6,000 建議區間的中段，而且兩條互相獨立的計算路徑算出來差不到 2.8%。第一步一定要先把交叉流量除以纖維數；直接把幫浦總流量代進單根纖維的公式，剪切會被高估到好幾倍，我們在不只一篇已發表的文件裡看到這個錯。有細胞壁的 Bacillus 不是 CHO 細胞，所以單次通過是安全的。未知的是累積暴露：每小時大約通過 138 次，而 van Reis 把蛋白聚集歸因於幫浦通過和夾帶空氣。
questions.trap_en: Quoting the 3 to 5 pascal ceiling from mammalian perfusion. It does not apply to a walled bacterium, and our own shear envelope is tabulated on eight fibres, which makes those numbers the conservative high ones.
questions.trap_zh: 拿哺乳動物灌流的 3 到 5 Pa 上限來套。那對有細胞壁的細菌不適用；而且我們自己的剪切表是用八根纖維算的，所以那些數字是偏保守、偏高的那一組。
questions.basis: wall shear is the master variable in their own scale-out argument and the divide-by-N error is in their own record

questions.q_en: Distinguish for me your recirculation rate from the residence time that actually matters to the biology, and tell me which one limits your control loop.
questions.q_zh: 請幫我區分「循環流量」和真正對生物有意義的「停留時間」，並說明哪一個才是控制迴路的限制。
questions.a_en: They differ by orders of magnitude and people confuse them constantly. At 263 millilitres a minute a single pass down a 0.6 metre fibre takes under a second, so recirculation sets wall shear and mixing, not how long anything stays. The time that matters is the shell exchange time, our system time constant: about 150 minutes at 2 LMH and about fifteen at twenty. Against that, the dead time is dominated by the CcaS activation half-time of 105 minutes, so the ratio of dead time to time constant lands between 0.7 and 7. Raising the flux shortens the time constant and makes control worse, which is why we cannot pick the delivery rate on plant grounds alone.
questions.a_zh: 這兩個差了好幾個數量級，很多人會混在一起。263 mL/min 之下，菌液通過 0.6 公尺的纖維一趟不到一秒，所以循環流量決定的是壁剪切和混合，不是停留多久。真正有意義的是殼側換液時間，也就是系統時間常數：2 LMH 大約 150 分鐘，20 LMH 大約 15 分鐘。相對地，死區時間由 CcaS 的活化半時 105 分鐘主導，所以死區時間對時間常數的比值落在 0.7 到 7 之間。把通量拉高會縮短時間常數，控制反而更難，所以輸送速率不能只按植物端的需求來定。
questions.trap_en: Calling the fast recirculation a short response time. The loop is dead-time dominated by the light switch, so pumping faster does not make the system respond faster.
questions.trap_zh: 把快速循環說成反應時間短。這個迴路是被光開關的死區時間主導的，幫浦打更快不會讓系統反應更快。
questions.basis: the dead-time-to-time-constant ratio is what fixes what the device can be used for

questions.q_en: Tell me how oxygen and carbon dioxide get into and out of a closed recirculating loop, and what you measured.
questions.q_zh: 一個封閉的循環迴路，氧氣和二氧化碳是怎麼進出的？你們實際量了什麼？
questions.a_en: We measured neither, and we worked around oxygen by guessing. Our sheet says the culture needs a kLa of about 12.5 per hour at carrying capacity, modest for a sparged tank and hard for a closed loop with no gas port. A hundred millilitre loop at thirty per cent of saturation holds about two minutes of oxygen at that demand. We could not calibrate the dissolved oxygen sensor and neither probe can be autoclaved, so it is not on the bioreactor. When the 8 October run showed few bubbles we suspected oxygen shortage and took the next run from one litre back to 500 millilitres. Carbon dioxide we never measured, and the pH loop adds base only, no acid.
questions.a_zh: 兩個我們都沒量，氧氣的部分是靠猜來繞過的。我們的計算說菌液在承載上限時需要 kLa 大約 12.5 /h，這對有通氣的發酵槽不難，對一個沒有氣體入口的封閉迴路卻很吃力。100 毫升的迴路在三成飽和度下，按那個需求只夠用大約兩分鐘。我們的溶氧感測器校不起來，而且兩種探頭都不能高壓滅菌，所以它根本沒裝在反應器上。10 月 8 日那次看到氣泡很少，我們懷疑缺氧，所以下一次運轉就把培養液從 1 公升降回 500 毫升。二氧化碳我們從來沒量，而且 pH 迴路只加鹼、不加酸。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the volume change fixed the oxygen problem. It was a hypothesis acted on without a dissolved oxygen reading, so the cause of the pH drift is still unproven. Professor Chang also advised a mechanical foam breaker and none is in the build.
questions.trap_zh: 說把體積降下來就解決了缺氧。那只是在沒有溶氧讀數的情況下照假設行動，pH 漂移的原因到現在還沒證實。另外張教授建議過機械破泡裝置，實際機器裡並沒有。
questions.basis: oxygen caps density before anything else and the sensor that would show it is the one they could not get working

questions.q_en: Why is a Bacillus culture in your recirculating loop not the same organism it is in a shake flask?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼同一株 Bacillus 在你們的循環迴路裡，跟在搖瓶裡其實不是同一回事？
questions.a_en: Because position inside the loop changes the reading and the growth. In our first loop run the tube finished at OD 0.304 while the reservoir read 0.48, which told us that without mixing an in-line sample underestimates the culture and that cells were settling and nutrients stratifying. Adding a stirrer at 200 rpm and moving the sampler to the reservoir outlet fixed it. I should be careful with the flask comparison, though: in that first run the flask control was at 37 degrees while the loop was at 22, so the two arms were not matched, and the next cycle changed the stirrer, the temperature and the sampling point all at once.
questions.a_zh: 因為在迴路裡的位置會改變讀數，也會改變生長。我們第一次跑迴路時，管內最後是 OD 0.304，儲液瓶卻是 0.48，這告訴我們：沒有混合的話，在線取樣會低估整體菌液，而且細胞在沉降、養分在分層。後來加了 200 rpm 的攪拌、把取樣點移到儲液瓶出口就改善了。不過搖瓶那個比較我必須講清楚：第一次運轉的搖瓶對照是 37 度，迴路卻是 22 度，兩組條件並不對等；而下一輪又同時改了攪拌、溫度和取樣位置三件事。
questions.trap_en: Saying the loop beat the flask. The 37 degree comparison, plateau in two hours against four and a half, is one run each and changed three variables at once; the 22 degree comparison was not temperature-matched at all.
questions.trap_zh: 說迴路贏過搖瓶。37 度那個比較（2 小時對 4.5 小時到平台）各只有一次，而且一次改了三個變數；22 度那個比較連溫度都沒有對齊。
questions.basis: the loop-versus-flask claim is the project's most-quoted reactor result and its weakest controlled comparison

questions.q_en: Is this a chemostat? Tell me the washout condition for your reactor, what a steady state would look like in your own data, and what your longest run actually demonstrated.
questions.q_zh: 這算是連續培養槽嗎？請說明你們反應器的沖洗條件、在你們自己的數據裡穩態長什麼樣子，以及你們最長那次運轉真正證明了什麼。
questions.a_en: No, and the membrane is exactly why. In a chemostat dilution must stay below the maximum growth rate or the cells wash out; here the permeate leaves and the biomass does not, so dilution can exceed growth freely. That is the defining property of perfusion. Our governing quantity is cell-specific perfusion rate: ours is about 0.0007 nanolitres per cell per day against a modern band of 0.02 to 0.5, so we feed lean. A steady state would be a flat optical density at constant flux, and we have never held one: the 17 October run climbed from 0.19 to 3.34 over 77 hours. We also have no level sensing and no closed-loop feeding, so what leaves is not replaced.
questions.a_zh: 不是，而原因正好就是那層膜。連續培養槽的稀釋率必須低於最大生長率，否則菌會被沖掉；我們這裡滲透液會離開、菌體不會，所以稀釋率可以隨意超過生長率。這就是灌流的定義性質。我們真正的主控量是細胞比灌流率，我們大約是每顆細胞每天 0.0007 奈升，而現代灌流的區間是 0.02 到 0.5，所以我們餵得非常稀。穩態應該長成通量固定、OD 打平，而我們從來沒維持過：10 月 17 日那次 77 小時從 0.19 一路爬到 3.34。另外我們沒有液位偵測、也沒有閉環補料，抽走的並沒有補回去。
questions.trap_en: Calling the long runs perfusion steady states. What 116 hours in September and 77 hours in October demonstrate is that the loop can be left alone for days with its instruments logging, not that density was held.
questions.trap_zh: 把那幾次長時間運轉說成灌流穩態。九月的 116 小時和十月的 77 小時真正證明的是「迴路可以帶著儀器自己記錄、好幾天不用管」，不是密度被維持住了。
questions.basis: perfusion versus chemostat is the single most likely conceptual question in the Biomanufacturing village

questions.q_en: Your Safety page says automated alerts trigger containment protocols on transmembrane pressure and that droplet leakage is detected. Your bioreactor page calls both of those planned. Which is true, and what does containment rest on today?
questions.q_zh: 你們 Safety 頁寫跨膜壓會自動警報、觸發圍阻程序，也寫會偵測滴漏。可是 Bioreactor 頁把這兩件事都列為規劃中。哪個才是真的？今天圍阻實際靠的是什麼？
questions.a_en: The bioreactor page is accurate and the Safety page overstates it. Pressure is read at three ports and shown on the dashboard, but today those numbers are only displayed; the alarm that stops the pump and opens the pinch valve is a planned firmware change, and the droplet sensor is one sensor and a tray we have not fitted. The shell-side breach detector is fitted with no breach test on record. So containment today is the membrane plus procedure: two shell-side platings with no replicate and no log reduction value, and a rule that the shell side is plated on the first run after every module change, with the harvest treated as live culture until that plate grows nothing.
questions.a_zh: Bioreactor 頁才是準確的，Safety 頁講得太滿。壓力在三個接口都有讀、也顯示在儀表板上，但目前就只是顯示；那個會停幫浦、打開夾管閥的警報是規劃中的固件修改，滴漏感測器則是一顆還沒裝的新感測器加一個集水盤。殼側破損偵測器是裝了，但沒有任何破損測試的紀錄。所以今天的圍阻是膜加上流程：兩次殼側塗盤，沒有重複、沒有對數削減值；另外一條規則是每次換模組後的第一次運轉都要塗殼側，而且在那盤長不出東西之前，收穫液一律當成活菌處理。
questions.trap_en: Defending the Safety page's wording. Also do not claim a fibre break shows up in the pressure trace: the manual says a few kilopascals in normal operation against a sensor good to about ten, and the manual itself forbids pressure monitoring standing in for looking.
questions.trap_zh: 替 Safety 頁的寫法辯護。也不要說斷纖維會在壓力曲線上看出來：手冊寫正常運轉只有幾個 kPa，而感測器精度大約是 10 kPa；手冊自己也明訂壓力監測不能取代用眼睛檢查。
questions.basis: two pages of the same wiki disagree about whether the containment alarms exist

questions.q_en: You scale out rather than up. Name the quantity that does not come along for free, and tell me where the first wall is.
questions.q_zh: 你們選的是複製單元而不是放大槽體。哪一個量不會自動跟著變好？第一道牆會撞在哪裡？
questions.a_en: Membrane area comes free and almost nothing else does. Replicating a fixed module holds wall shear, permeate flux and the fouling margin constant by construction, which is the published linear scale-up rule, so area goes from 200 to 1,600 square centimetres with no new physics. The wall is power. Each module needs its own recirculation pump running continuously, three to eight watts, so eight modules draw 24 to 64, and a 45 watt panel harvests about 101 watt hours a day. Medium binds in aggregate at 7.7 litres a day. Oxygen binds per unit. The membrane is last on that list, which is both the point of the design and the warning.
questions.a_zh: 只有膜面積是免費跟上的，其他幾乎都不是。複製一個固定模組，壁剪切、滲透通量和結垢餘裕在設計上就維持不變，這就是文獻上的線性放大法則，所以面積從 200 平方公分變成 1,600 不需要新的物理。真正的牆是電力。每個模組都要有自己的循環幫浦持續運轉，3 到 8 瓦，八個模組就是 24 到 64 瓦，而 45 瓦的太陽能板一天只收到大約 101 瓦時。培養基是總量上的限制，一天 7.7 公升。氧氣是每一台各自的限制。膜排在這張清單的最後，這既是設計的用意，也是警訊。
questions.trap_en: Answering with membrane area or permeate rate. Those are the two quantities that do scale; the binding ones are medium, pumping power, oxygen and energy.
questions.trap_zh: 拿膜面積或滲透速率來回答。那兩個正好是會跟著放大的；真正會卡住的是培養基、幫浦電力、氧氣和能源。
questions.basis: Biomanufacturing is a nominated area and the scale-out table is the page's core argument

questions.q_en: Hollow-fibre perfusion is a mature industrial technology. Tell me honestly what is not novel about your reactor.
questions.q_zh: 中空纖維灌流是一項成熟的工業技術。老實告訴我，你們這台反應器有哪些部分其實不新？
kw_zh: 交叉流截留是標準做法
questions.a_en: Almost all of the separation, and we should not pretend otherwise. Crossflow microfiltration for cell retention, perfusion as an operating mode and the hollow-fibre format are standard bioprocess practice. Van Reis published the linear scale-up method we use in 1997 and carried a 400-fold scale-up with it; Maiorella characterised crossflow of cells in 1991; the critical flux concept we quote is Field in 1995. Our cartridge is a bought vendor part, a Cobetter Biophsep MiniLab, mPES, 0.2 micron, and the pump, the transducers and the flow meter are catalogue items. We did not invent perfusion. What is ours is a very small configuration, run with cells, and a written record of what it did and did not do.
questions.a_zh: 分離這一塊幾乎都不是新的，我們不該假裝。用交叉流微過濾留住細胞、用灌流當操作模式、用中空纖維當形式，都是標準的生物製程做法。我們用的線性放大法是 van Reis 1997 年發表的，他當年還靠它做了 400 倍放大；Maiorella 1991 年就描述過細胞的交叉流過濾；我們引用的臨界通量概念來自 Field 1995。我們的膜柱是買來的廠商零件，Cobetter Biophsep MiniLab、mPES、0.2 微米，幫浦、壓力傳送器和流量計也都是目錄上的貨。我們沒有發明灌流。真正屬於我們的是一個非常小的組態、真的拿細胞跑過，以及一份寫下來的、說清楚做到與沒做到什麼的紀錄。
questions.trap_en: Claiming membrane containment as the team's invention. Dr Brophy told us in April to make physical containment primary rather than a kill switch, and Professor Chen told us in April to keep the bacteria in a vessel. The idea came from reviewers.
questions.trap_zh: 把膜圍阻說成團隊的發明。Brophy 博士四月就告訴我們要以物理圍阻為主、不要靠自殺開關，陳教授四月也說把細菌留在容器裡。這個想法是審查者給的。
questions.basis: a judge who knows bioprocessing will test whether the team knows the field it sits in

questions.q_en: What previous iGEM work and open hardware does this build on, and what did you add on top of it?
questions.q_zh: 你們是站在哪些過去的 iGEM 作品和開源硬體上？你們自己又加了什麼？
questions.a_en: Quite a lot, and we try to name every piece. Our light plate follows the Light Plate Apparatus from Gerhardt and colleagues in 2016 and is named after it; the CcaS and CcaR switch comes from Castillo-Hair in 2019, not from us. Our fluidics reference was an open-source peristaltic pump from iGEM Aachen 2017, and we used an Aachen hardware page as our quality bar. Before building the photometer we reviewed twenty-two prior open-source builds. What we added is the dual-wavelength column layout with output-matched LEDs, the in-line dual-beam photometer whose reference channel never sees the culture, and the alarm that flagged that photometer 26.7 hours before its reading failed.
questions.a_zh: 很多，而且我們盡量把每一樣都寫出來。我們的光板沿用 Gerhardt 等人 2016 年的 Light Plate Apparatus，連名字都是跟它取的；CcaS 與 CcaR 的開關來自 Castillo-Hair 2019，不是我們想的。流體部分我們參考的是 iGEM Aachen 2017 的開源蠕動幫浦，也拿 Aachen 的硬體頁面當我們的品質標竿。做光度計之前，我們先比較過二十二個前人的開源版本。我們自己加上去的是：雙波長的欄位配置搭配按實測輸出配對的 LED、參考通道永遠看不到菌液的在線雙光束光度計，還有那個在讀數失效前 26.7 小時就示警的警報。
questions.trap_en: Overclaiming the light plate or the optogenetic switch as original. Our own LPA page says the pattern and the biology are from the literature, and that only the column layout, the matched LEDs and the enclosure are ours.
questions.trap_zh: 把光板或光遺傳開關說成原創。我們自己的 LPA 頁就寫了型式和生物學都來自文獻，只有欄位配置、配對過的 LED 和外殼是我們的。
questions.basis: positioning against prior art, where the team's own pages are unusually explicit

questions.q_en: Last question. Why should I be impressed by this rig rather than by a bought one?
questions.q_zh: 最後一個問題。我為什麼該對你們這台機器印象深刻，而不是對一台買來的？
questions.a_en: Cost, integration and documentation, not invention. Our known materials come to 1,022 US dollars, with the membrane the largest single line at 245, and the controller and its mainboard are not even in that total. It is wired into the biology: the pinch valve exists because an expert found that nothing drove the protectant across, and every interlock lives in the microcontroller, so a dead browser cannot push the loop past a limit. The documentation is an 82-page notebook over 30 weeks, a ten-page assembly guide, a sixteen-page manual, the STLs and MIT-licensed software. And we have not costed any of it against what a farmer buys today, which is the comparison you are really asking for.
questions.a_zh: 是成本、整合和文件，不是發明。我們已知的材料費是 1,022 美元，最大單項是薄膜 245 美元，而控制器和它的主板根本還沒算進這個總額。它也真的接進生物：夾管閥會存在，是因為專家指出沒有任何東西把保護蛋白推過膜；而且每一條連鎖都跑在微控制器裡，瀏覽器掛掉也推不動迴路越界。文件方面是 30 週、82 頁的筆記本，10 頁組裝指南，16 頁使用手冊，STL 檔，加上 MIT 授權的軟體。另外要誠實說，我們還沒有把這些成本跟農民今天買得到的東西做過比較，而那其實正是你想問的。
questions.trap_en: Saying the photometer replaces a fifteen thousand dollar instrument. Our own pages price the BioDrop at NT$15,000, about 470 US dollars, against 371.78 for the Pro, so the argument is in-line continuous measurement, not price.
questions.trap_zh: 說光度計取代了一台一萬五千美元的儀器。我們自己的頁面寫 BioDrop 是新台幣 15,000 元、大約 470 美元，而 Pro 是 371.78 美元，所以真正的論點是在線連續量測，不是價格。
questions.basis: the question a hardware judge actually decides the nomination on
